items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I knew Cutty. I played with him you know, more than a few times at the Eddie Condon’s in midtown in the 50s.

ctx.x: Um, they really grab it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
Yeah. Zoom — zoom — zoom. And I’d just stand in front of them and I enjoyed that so much. And I’ll tell you there’s a funny thing. You ever hear of a trombone player named Cutty Cutshall?
